'''1998 Shawn Valdez Tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 29 August 1998 at Bristol. [[Rod Latham]] finished 6th of 15. Decipher sponsored a nationwide weekend that month dedicated to [[Shawn Valdez (player)|Shawn Valdez]].<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst3">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst3.htm Baragwin Retrieval], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195633/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst3.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst3">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst3.htm Walker Garrison], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183515/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst3.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 29 August 1998
* '''Site:''' Bristol
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

The deck pages are dated 29 August 1998 and their records add up to 3–1, matching the Bristol entry on Latham's results page.
